research.name: Piou
research.note: Python CLI library whose typed commands also run as a slash-command TUI with live suggestions and argument hints.

effects: slash-command TUI mode generated from the same typed CLI definition, with a filtered suggestion list and inline usage/argument hints under the prompt
Poetry-style Rich help output with uppercase section headings and colored command names
